items.title: Resumable incremental FTS indexing
items.description: Replace one-shot capped builds with resumable indexing and explicit complete, indexed, and remaining results.
acceptance: A capped build reports incomplete work instead of a success-shaped count.
A caller can resume without losing prior indexed progress.
Results expose complete, indexed, and remaining counts.

items.title: Tenant and APP FTS namespace isolation
items.description: Keep default FTS projections tenant-local and APP projections bound to registered tenant/name namespaces.
acceptance: Unrelated tenants and registered APP namespaces cannot see each other's indexed keys.
Persistence and autoload remain bound to the configured scope.

items.title: Per-node replication convergence reports
items.description: Report missing records, divergent digests, orphaned keys, and replication lag per peer; current REPL.STATUS reports only partial counts and sync timestamps.
acceptance: Reports identify the peer and missing-record count.
Reports include comparable digests for divergent records.
Reports expose a bounded, meaningful per-peer lag measure.
Orphaned-key counts and sync failures are explicit.

items.title: Structured degraded-health reporting
items.description: Expose partial hydration, stale indexes, and failed seeds as structured health details; current published INFO does not cover all of these states.
acceptance: Health distinguishes healthy, degraded, and unavailable states.
Partial hydration, stale indexes, and failed seeds have actionable reasons.
Unknown state is not reported as healthy.

items.title: Acknowledged-write read-back and restart regression coverage
items.description: Add regression coverage for read-back after an acknowledged write and recovery after restart, including intermittent nil-GET behavior.
acceptance: An acknowledged write is immediately readable through the RESP path.
The value is recovered after a cold restart of the actual store.
A regression reproduces and prevents the intermittent nil-GET behavior.
